574-1445-1913-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.

574-1445-1913-4871.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Mister Fantastic ability, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
